name: ocean-surf
description: Sea and surf look for the Claude desktop app: an ocean palette in light and dark, and an animated beach scene behind the conversation that follows the real sun (day, golden hour, night).

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Where the sun is computed for the day, golden hour and night scenes, in degrees (-90 to 90). Default: Paris.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Where the sun is computed, in degrees east (-180 to 180; west is negative). Default: Paris.
